verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a first-party Cloudflare Workers edge integration that evaluates feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge. That edge path skips the network request to the API. A self-hosted Proxy serves as a relay layer, caching SDK payloads close to apps, streaming updates, and supporting remote evaluation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of edge evaluation, and documentation of edge platforms beyond Cloudflare Workers.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users

citations.quote: Evaluate GrowthBook feature flags and Visual Editor experiments at the edge on Cloudflare Workers to cut flicker before HTML ships.
This eliminates the network request to the GrowthBook API, unlocking blazingly fast edge-side and client-side SDK performance.
This evaluation happens wherever the SDK runs—in the browser, on your server, or at the edge.
Run the GrowthBook Proxy next to your app to cache SDK payloads, reduce latency, and keep serving flags if the API is down.
Remote Evaluation** - Hide your features' business logic in insecure environments
